description: Header file defining the AvcParameterSets class for parsing and handling AVC NAL units, including conversion between formats and retrieval of SPS/PPS data.

classes.name: AvcParameterSets
classes.description: Class for parsing AVC parameter sets (SPS/PPS) from NAL units, supporting format conversion and validation.

methods.name: AvcParameterSets
methods.description: Constructor that parses AVC parameter sets from input data in Annex B format.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the format of the parameter sets (kAnnexB or kHeadless).

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the parsed parameter sets are valid.

methods.name: has_sps_and_pps
methods.description: Checks if both SPS and PPS are present.

methods.name: first_sps
methods.description: Returns the first SPS parameter set.

methods.name: first_pps
methods.description: Returns the first PPS parameter set.

methods.name: GetAddresses
methods.description: Returns pointers to the stored parameter sets.

methods.name: GetSizesInBytes
methods.description: Returns sizes of each parameter set.

methods.name: combined_size_in_bytes
methods.description: Returns total size of all parameter sets.

methods.name: ConvertTo
methods.description: Converts parameter sets to a different format.
